headline: Cognitive Credit raises $40 million for specialist data and AI in credit markets
body: Cognitive Credit, a corporate credit data, analytics and AI provider, has closed a $40 million strategic growth investment led by Summit Partners, with participation from ETFS Capital.
note: For credit market players, a $40 million round shows that specialist data and AI still draw growth capital.

evidence.text: Cognitive Credit raises $40m to scale specialist data and AI for credit markets
Corporate credit data, analytics, and AI technology provider Cognitive Credit has closed a $40 million strategic growth investment led by Summit Partners with participation from ETFS Capital.
